about_the_game:
PPTB :  A Rogue-Lite Strategy Resource Management Game

Resource Management

Players will harvest four distinct resource types using Pipetubes, and use these resources to obtain progressively advanced Pipetubes, building increasingly complex pipelines to overcome escalating resource challenges.

Light Puzzle-Solving

Players will deal with procedrually generated event puzzles, to trigger different storyline.

Roguelite Element

Players will explore a procedurally generated world, with randomized Pipetube Cards and special efffect Stickers to create a unique experience for every new round of game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7 SP1 or plus
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.8 GHz or single-core 2.0 GHz or above (requires support for SSE2 instruction set)
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting DirectX 10/11 (Shader Model 4.0/5.0)
  • Sound Card: unrestricted

short_description: PPTB is a Rogue-Lite Strategy Resource Management game. Players will build “Pipelines” to gather 4 kinds of resources in order to fulfill recurring survival challenges and explore the game world.
